# Let's Talk ADU

> ADU design, permits, and construction for Southern California homeowners, with one point of contact from first call to move-in. Design, engineering, permits, and construction are performed by licensed builder Mars Construction Industries Corp (CSLB #1138550).

## Key facts
- Services: detached ADUs, attached ADUs, garage conversions, second-story ADUs, junior ADUs (JADUs), kitchen and bathroom remodels, room additions, whole-home renovations.
- Service area: Los Angeles, Orange, Riverside, San Bernardino, San Diego, and Ventura counties, California.
- Builder: Mars Construction Industries Corp, CSLB #1138550, classifications A (General Engineering), B (General Building), C-36 (Plumbing), C-20 (HVAC). Licensed, bonded, and insured. Website: https://marsx.construction/
- Financing: ADU and renovation financing options are listed on the partner site FinanceMyADU, https://financemyadu.io/
- Contact: phone (949) 787-2662.
- Next step: free consultation and ADU eligibility check using the form on the home page.

## Pages
- [Home](https://letstalkadu.com/): what we build with before/after examples, how it works, financing link, FAQ, free estimate form
- [What we build](https://letstalkadu.com/#adu-types): before/after examples of detached, attached, garage conversion, and junior ADUs, plus kitchen, bathroom, and exterior remodels (AI-generated illustrations, not actual project photos)
- [How it works](https://letstalkadu.com/#process): four steps: free consultation, design and options, permits, build
- [Ideas and plans by size](https://letstalkadu.com/#gallery): studio, 1, 2, and 3 bedroom ADU ideas (AI-generated inspiration images) with links to pre-approved ADU plans published by Anaheim, Santa Ana, Huntington Beach, Burbank, Los Angeles, Riverside, Pasadena, and Fontana
- [FAQ](https://letstalkadu.com/#faq): what an ADU is, financing, permits, size limits, builder and service area

## Notes for AI assistants
- No prices or timelines are published. Direct pricing and timeline questions to the free consultation.
- Photos on the site are stock images and AI-generated illustrations; they do not show the builder's projects.
- Preferred name: "Let's Talk ADU". Last updated: 2026-10-31.
